overview: Social and musical chronicle on the beginnings of a cultural revolution, this fiction in 6 episodes retraces the beginnings of the group NTM formed by Kool Shen and JoeyStarr and the emergence of the French hip hop scene in the 80s. characters of Dee Nasty, the first importer and DJ of rap music in France, and the dancer and graffiti artist Lady Five.
title: Le Monde de demain

overview: Limited series based on Adrian McKinty's upcoming novel described as an intense thriller that tells the story of a family trip that turns into a living nightmare.
title: The Island

overview: Limited series based on Blitz Bazawule's upcoming debut novel, which centers on Melvin and Bernadette, a Black couple fleeing persecution in 1960s America.
title: The Scent of Burnt Flowers

overview: The longtime mayor of Marseille is preparing to hand over the reins to his protégé when a sudden and ruthless battle erupts for control of the city.
title: Marseille

overview: The ISS, the International Space Station has gone silent. The crew is in distress. Simultaneously, a decapitated and waxed body is found on a roof in Kazakhstan. Positive identification leaves no room for doubt: the body belongs to an American astronaut currently on a mission on the ISS. A French astronaut, dismissed from the space program, and a Kazakh cop, disowned by his ranking hierarchy, set out to solve this mysterious paradox.
title: Infiniti

overview: Cha Cha Un is a popular, albeit somewhat sarcastic magician who creates spectacular performances on stage and on television. His tricks amaze the audience, but few people know — he has a team of secret assistants! However, these are not ordinary magician's assistants: in fact, they are ghosts. But Cha Cha Un is not afraid of creatures from the spirit realm — he treats them as his employees, and they, in turn, consider him their "boss". One day, his paths cross with Go Seul Hae – a young passionate police officer who can also see ghosts, but is afraid of her abilities. She's investigating an incident involving one of his magic shows. And soon she realizes that the unusual abilities of a magician can become an ideal tool in the fight against crime. She manages to convince him to join the police and help catch violent criminals using his ghostly retinue.
title: From Now On, Showtime!

overview: Leaving a trail of lies and deception in her wake, the police and her victims are left to piece together the mystery of who Melissa Caddick really was. To those closest to her, she was a daughter, wife, mother, and loyal friend. But as the pieces of the puzzle begin to crystallise and the police close in, a decomposing foot with an Asics running shoe still attached washes up on a sandy beach and turns everything about her disappearance on its head.
title: Underbelly: Vanishing Act

overview: Join in at home with fun activity ideas, songs and stories, for parents and toddlers. Hosted by Giovanna Fletcher and Nigel Clarke.
title: The Toddler Club At Home!

overview: Join in at home with fun activity ideas, songs and stories, for parents and toddlers.
title: The Toddler Club Songs

overview: The Toddler Club encourages parents, carers and their toddlers to spend time together and explore the world around them, through play, storytelling and songs. Join in at home too!
title: The Toddler Club

overview: The Kumagawa Hospital which is located in the outskirts of town. Ogami Runa joined as a nursing staff 2 weeks ago. One night, with the lights all turned low, her fellow colleague, Suzuki Ayako is terrified out of her wits when a woman dressed in a school uniform (sailor) with blood dripping all over her, appears before her. A few days later, Runa's childhood friend, Sakai Manami who works at a movie production company, calls her out for a meet-up. Ever since she was a child, when she saw the ghost of her dead schoolmate, Runa realises that she could sense and see the ghosts around her. Bullied by her other classmates, Manami is the only one who had befriended her. Due to her ability, Runa always tries to ignore talks of ghosts sightings by other nurses and patients. Amidst all these, the medical intern Kumagawa Asahi, whose father owns the hospital, has a strange fascination with the mysterious old hospital wing's top floor. One night, Runa goes to the old hospital wing to fetch some supplies, and she hears a voice calling out her name. Entranced, Runa follows the sound and goes up to the top floor. She bumps into the wall at the end of the corridor, and the sound seems to come from within. Perplexed, Runa stands there contemplating the wall, when all of a sudden, a door appears before her eyes...
title: Akuryo Byoutou

overview: An accidental love caused a hot-tempered guy like Dino to meet his love at first sight, Rak. Even though his name means Love, Rak's love life is unpleasant and miserable, so Dino tried his hardest to find him again and set on a mission to hit on Rak.
title: Dinosaur Love

overview: Tajimage Shu happens to meet Bessho Fumiyo, a former high school senior, by chance. He is a popular guy with many girlfriends. But he has to end these relationships out of necessity. After hearing his story, Fumiyo unintentionally mutters that this situation is exactly like Dazai Osamu's unfinished novel 'Goodbye'. Tajimage is moved by the queer coincidence. Adapted from a manga "Goodbye" by Hanyunyū Jun which based on Dazai Osamu's unfinished novel with the same name.
title: Goodbye

overview: Kento enjoys cooking with canned foods and eating them at a camp-ground. Nanako likes cooking with natural ingredients she obtains herself from nature. The only thing in common between Kento and Nanako are that they eat and sleep alone at camp. Through the people they meet at camps, they both become fascinated with the world of food.
title: Hitori Camp de Kutte Neru

overview: The successes and struggles of farming in Ireland from the perspectives and experiences of a range of farmers and their families.
title: A Farmer's Life

overview: Memorable incidents involving famous faces.
title: The Most Shocking Celebrity Moments

overview: It is a comedy drama depicting the company life with us. Flatulence, booger, sexual harassment, but tears are fragile! ?? A story of cute uncles who are laughing and relaxing, filled with uncle's "Aruaru". Rookie OL Kana, who was longing for Marunouchi OL, joined "Bisui Shoji", a wholesale company of small water purifiers of Shimomaruko, which is different from "Maru". The employees of Mimizu Shoji were uncle, except Kana! Kana, who was shocked by the characters of the uncles who were too intense and the many rare behaviors, began to keep a "Uncle Observation Diary."
title: OL Kana no Ojisan Kansatsu Nikki

overview: Mai used to live in a messy room, but now has an obsession with decluttering. She wants to live a "Nannimo Nai" Lifestyle. However, when friends visit, they are shocked by her extreme lack of belongings. Her habits also conflict with her mother, Fumi, and her grandmother, Hatsuko, who prefer not to throw anything away. Mai finds emotional support from her husband, Tsutomu, and two cats as she examines the relationship between her possessions and her life. ~~ Based on the manga with the same name Yururi Mai.
title: Watashi no Uchi ni wa, Nanimo Nai

overview: Needless to say, "Short Short God" Shinichi Hoshi. More than 1001 works published throughout his life have been published in textbooks and are still being read. Its charm, loved by generations, is the mysterious and exciting elements of science fiction and fantasy, such as "space," "robots," and "devils." Also, a perspective that is mixed with "funnyness" and "irony" toward humans and society. And above all, it's a short but fascinating story that will surprise you. I will draw such a gem of Shinichi Hoshi as a live-action drama now in Reiwa. In the appearance, there are a lot of talented and individual actors who support this live-action project and love Shinichi Hoshi's work, so to speak, "Shinichi Hoshi Children". The lineup is suitable for the diverse world view of Shinichi Hoshi's works, which is like turning a toy box upside down.
title: Hoshi Shinichi no Fushigina Fushigina Tanpen Dorama

overview: Five 35-year-old women with different backgrounds and personalities – a minor celebrity, an ordinary housewife, a single mother whose son is at a rebellious age, a beautiful super elite whom everyone envies and a writer whose popularity is on the wane – happen to meet because they are all fans of the idol group Snow White which debuted three years ago. They develop friendships and begin to reexamine their own lives.
title: Kongai Renai ni Nita Mono

overview: The presenter begins a series of voyages.
title: Susan Calman's Cruise of a Lifetime

overview: A series in which historians consider occasions when the Second World War might have been avoided, and the nature of the policy of the appeasement prior to, and in the early stages of, the war.
title: Hitler: Could He Have Been Stopped?
Mes amis, mes amours, mes emmerdes

overview: Freddie Flintoff and Jamie Redknapp travel around Britain and Ireland, taking on audacious challenges with a variety of famous faces.
title: A League of Their Own Road Trip: Dingle to Dover

overview: In this exciting five-part history series, Curse of the Ancients Professor Alice Roberts reveals how scientists are unearthing the evidence for cataclysmic events in the past and their disastrous consequences. From wars to earthquakes and floods to famines – these are the events that have helped shape our modern world. In each episode, Alice takes viewers on a journey across Europe and North Africa to discover epic sites and landmarks - fabulous cities abandoned, battlefields long forgotten and sophisticated civilisations toppled and lost to the mists of time. To our ancient ancestors, suffering these catastrophic events, it must have seemed they were cursed but science is now exploding those myths and re-writing history.
title: Curse of the Ancients with Alice Roberts

overview: A look at what it was really like to live and survive during one of the most devastating conflicts the world has ever seen.
title: Weeks of War

overview: Explore the bizarre mating rituals of the ocean's most peculiar creatures, from bloody battles to super-size litters.
title: Alien Abyss

overview: The Full Monty will follow the original cast as they navigate the post-industrial city of Sheffield and society's crumbling healthcare, education and employment sectors and explore how communal effort can still triumph over adversity.
title: The Full Monty

overview: Stonehouse relates how Labour minister John Stonehouse, a high-flying member of Harold Wilson's Government, vanished from the beach of a large luxury hotel in Florida in November 1974, leaving a neatly folded pile of clothes as he swam into the sea, intent on faking his own death.
title: Stonehouse

overview: Discover the new insights on the universe and the origin of life that put us in the middle of a Copernican revolution. In this three-part series, we take a look at the monumental discoveries underway, specifically surrounding black holes, meteorites and exoplanets. Black holes have been revealed as one of the foundations for the basic conditions of life. Through black holes, life is possible in an infinite number of places in space. We show how meteorites brought the basic substances of life to our planet, allowing for its creation, and we look at exoplanets as a possible habitat for humankind. The films describe the latest findings concerning cosmic events in relation to the origin of life, providing a grandiose perspective of what makes life possible.
title: Leben aus dem All

overview: One day, Adachi-san is approached by the editor-in-chief of a female magazine with a proposal to run a series about throwing away a personal belonging in each issue, based on the theme of parting with possessions and living more comfortably. That night, Adachi-san falls asleep like always. But a mysterious girl and the personification of the items that she has held onto appear one after another in her dream, asking to be thrown away.
title: Throw It Away, Adachi

overview: Ohm and Nanon come together once again to challenge themselves to all activities they have never done before. Ready to complete challenging level up missions, who can upgrade more levels in this event? Follow in Ohm Nanon Upvel every other Monday at 6 PM.
title: Ohm Nanon Upvel

overview: Kevin Bedard, a brilliant and ambitious millennial, founds with two friends a startup that develops an application that allows him to dialogue with the deceased through their digital traces. The road to success will not be smooth and the rapid expansion of the company will lead to unfortunate consequences that will force its founder to make questionable ethical choices.
title: Manuel De La Vie Sauvage

overview: The hour-long, 10-episode drama centers on tech genius Lindy, a 21-year-old hacker with a gift for seeing clues and connections in the digital world that others can't. Persuaded by her roommate to try online dating, Lindy begins to suspect that one of her suitors is a deadly cyber stalker. When the local cyber-crimes unit uncovers a potential serial killer in Manhattan, all signs point to this mysterious stalker. Teaming up with the cyber unit and some hacker friends, Lindy leads the charge to solve these murders while unleashing her own style of justice on the streets of New York City.
title: Eye Candy

overview: French thriller serial about a missing teenager. As the police investigate, the girl's friends and family are revealed as a suspicious set of characters, each with secrets of their own.
title: Disparue

overview: Three days in the life of Slobodan Milosevic's family before his arrest.
title: Porodica

overview: Ina Garten welcomes old and new friends into her home for good food, great conversation and lots of fun. Her guests include actress Julianna Margulies, broadcaster Willie Geist and chef and restaurateur Erin French.
title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten

overview: The madness in Hardanger reaches new heights. Lothepus and his colorful crew will build Norway's roughest campsite in Odda. Stave church, small plane, longhouse and excavator park are some of the extravagant plans.
title: Lothepus Camping

overview: The Yorkshire Dales is one of the UK's hottest property markets… and finding families a stone built cottage in an idyllic village means long days for property guru Marcus Alderson and his sales team. Now Really is joining Britain's most entertaining estate agents in the office and on the road dealing in dream homes set in the stunning North Yorkshire landscape… There'll be stunning renovations, new builds in gorgeous places and drama as sellers race to secure a sale and buyers rush to find a piece of heaven in the hills. Our stars are Marcus and his agents – Carla, Richard, Rosie and Sue – and their clients, drawn to dales that are more familiar to most as holiday destinations… with amazing aerial photography, big characters and dreams coming true, Dales for Sale is unmissable viewing.
title: Dales for Sale

overview: Catching a glimpse of the day to day lives of police officers. Body cameras capture the demanding day-to-day work of UK police officers as they respond to emergencies, investigate crimes and arrest suspects.
title: This Cop Life

overview: A gourmet comedy featuring 12 girls who are fascinated by gourmet burgers. Two girls appear every episode and develop in omnibus format. In addition, all the stores that appear are real stores, and we pay particular attention to the lighting and the sound of baking patties, and depict the gourmet burgers at each store with a sizzling feeling
title: Women's Gourmet Burger Club

overview: Matsumoto Shouen entered monkhood because he could not rescue his childhood friend who was drowning right in front of him when he was a kid. Wanting to save the lives of the people important to him in their last moments, he also aspired to be a doctor. At the hospital, Shouen engages in medical care as an emergency doctor and also chants sutra for the deceased at the morgue or provides psychological care for terminally ill patients as a Buddhist monk. As a result, there are times when he treats patients brought into the emergency centre while he is in his robes and causes them to jump to the conclusion that they have died. Although he is disliked not only by patients but also colleagues for chanting prayers to Buddha and preaching for everything, he is cheerful and sincere. As Shouen grapples with how he should save lives, attend to deaths and support the families of patients, he grows as a doctor, a monk and a person.
title: Byoshitsu de Nembutsu o Tonaenaide Kudasai

overview: A bitter love story depicting the realities of love between a female college students who earn money as a stand-in girlfriend, and men attracted to them.
title: Tomorrow, I'll Be Someone's Girlfriend

overview: An outbreak of zombies in a local city! The only ones who can stand up to them are three women around 30 and their friends! In the midst of the battle, their hidden desires begin to seethe in strange ways! In this socially-conscious black comedy, Tomoya Sakurai, an up-and-coming playwright who sees "zombies" as a symbol of the dangers and anxieties of modern life, exposes the various problems of modern Japan.
title: Zombie ga Kita kara Jinsei Mitsumenaoshita

overview: Within the French secret service, one department known as the DGSE manages the missions of all undercover operatives working under fake identities to identify intelligence sources.
title: Le Bureau des Légendes

overview: In HSI: Puerto Rico a passionate Homeland Security agent reluctantly returns home to Puerto Rico where she works with her talented but jaded training officer as part of an elite HSI team working tirelessly as the first line of defense against all manner of threats to the United States.
title: HSI: Puerto Rico

overview: After returning to his hometown of Yantarsk, Mikhail Samoylov, an officer in the Russian armed forces, has to tell a friend that she is now a widow. But not all is quiet in this coastal town. After getting a job offer to work as a security expert at a local port, Mikhail finds out that corruption and crime is everywhere and he has to go to war to bring peace back to his hometown.
title: Порт

overview: Four superpowered pups work as a pack to help their new kid pals — and a furry alien friend — in a cute and cuddly cosmic adventure!
title: Super PupZ

overview: Hailed as one of the best sci-fi novels of the decade, Dark Matter is a story about the road not taken. The series follows Jason Dessen, a physicist, professor, and family man who – one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago – is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the multiverse of lives he could have lived. In this labyrinth of mind-bending realities, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from the most terrifying, unbeatable foe imaginable: himself.
title: Dark Matter

overview: The special features an exclusive interview with Carolyn Warmus, as well as the Greenburgh PD investigator who worked the case from beginning to end; Westchester County, New York prosecutors; jurors and reporters who covered the story first hand. All reveal what they thought about the case then and how they view it now. Throughout the in-depth special, Warmus, who never testified in her own defense on the advice of her counsel, shares her truth. She has always maintained her innocence. With no physical evidence to support her guilt, those who investigated the case and worked to secure her conviction offer the circumstantial evidence that led to Warmus' sentence. While Warmus' first, grueling, months-long court ordeal ended in a mistrial, she was retried and convicted soon after.
title: The Fatal Attraction Murder

overview: Brazilian Drag Queen Pabllo Vittar and Brazilian singer Luíza Sonza host this competition that will present Drag Queens facing a number of challenges in search of the 'pop crown'.
title: Queen Stars Brasil
Wie denk je wel dat je bent

overview: Aihara Mei is single and works hard as a medical representative with a pharmaceutical company. Efficient at work, she struggles with housework on the home front. On the night of her 28th birthday, a stranger Shigino Nagisa, appears on her doorstep. Claiming to be an excellent housekeeper, he offers his services to tidy up her messy home. Despite her misgivings, Mei ends up hiring him. Meanwhile, another stranger Tadokoro Yuta, a medical representative with a rival pharmaceutical company comes into Mei`s life.
title: Watashi no Kaseifu Nagisa-san

overview: Toshiro proposes to his girlfriend of three years, Akiko, but Akiko disappears the next day, leaving the engagement ring behind. In this perspective, Toshiro is tracking down his vanished fiancée.
title: Kanojo no Ura Sekai: Toshiro Side

overview: In The 1% Club, 100 contestants begin every show - but to make it to the end and win the top prize of up to £100,000, contestants must correctly answer a question only 1% of the country would get right.
title: The 1% Club

overview: In the future humans are extinct and robots rule the world. A sentient slot machine, lamp and jackhammer are members of the robot high council. They have unearthed ancient video chats of human celebrities sharing stories of sex, love, and money. In an effort to understand their creators better the robots watch these time capsules of humanity and ask themselves: Why R Humans?
title: Why R Humans?

overview: Taking place in the ‘60s, the show explores the origins of the curse that would haunt the small Maine town for the next 27 years — as well as the origin story of Pennywise the Clown.
title: IT: Welcome to Derry

overview: Comedy with sketches presenting the daily life of four couples and two roommates of different ages and backgrounds. In a realistic tone, this comedy explores in a raw and disarming way all the facets of the couple, without filter in the intimacy of the bedroom, one of the only places where you can really be yourself.
title: Entre deux draps

overview: Today, everything happens online! We consume, we look for love, we pay our bills, we train… we do almost everything! With all the humor we know him for, Mehdi Bousaidan wants to make viewers think about their current habits, lead them to develop a critical look at the digital world and not offer them the latest fashionable gadget. His sidekick, Nellie Brière, will popularize the social issues related to the omnipresence of digital technology in our lives.
title: En Ligne

overview: Yuuri Kariya is an airhead who falls head-over-heels in love with Ryuuhei Aono after their very first meeting. Yuuri's happiness knows no bounds when Aono surprisingly ends up agreeing to go out with her, and thus she starts to enjoy her perfect relationship with her perfect boyfriend. Alas, misfortune strikes when only two weeks into their relationship, Aono tragically dies in an accident. But is something as simple as death really enough to keep the two lovers apart?
title: I Want to Hold Aono-kun so Badly I Could Die

overview: A new employee, Segawa Haruto, has arrived at the pharmaceutical company where Aihara Mei works. In the first year of working life, a trial suddenly comes to Haruto who doesn't know right or left. Haruto, who desperately followed Mei's work, had a broken heart in just one day, said, "I'm not fit for this job...". A petite growth story begins, watching over the imadoki boy Haruto-kun until he becomes a full-fledged member of society!
title: Watashi no buka no Haruto-kun

overview: English Lord Brett Sinclair and American Danny Wilde are both wealthy playboys; they are teamed together by Judge Fulton to investigate crimes which the police can't solve.
title: The Persuaders

overview: That year is a great cultural plateau led by Marc Labrèche and his collaborators, Simon Boulerice, Émilie Perreault and Fred Savard. Each week, starting from a significant year in our history, they revisit the culture of yesterday and measure it against that of today. Together with their guests, they explore subjects that link the chosen year to what is igniting the contemporary cultural world. Bridging two eras, they share favourites, discoveries and classics. A program where we discuss, question and remember, without taking ourselves too seriously.
title: Cette Annee La

overview: Nadia and Martín have been a couple for so long they're starting to forget what brought them together in the first place. They have considered breaking up but there is one major issue: who will keep Amsterdam, the stray dog they rescued?
title: Amsterdam

overview: In the forest, ten chefs compete in the wildest culinary competition. Dropped on site by a seaplane.
title: Chefs De Bois

overview: Each summer, thousands flock to the Deschutes River in Oregon for the best whitewater rafting in the Pacific Northwest. The river's raft guides must navigate the rapids of crazy nightlife, demanding bosses, volatile relationships and wild clients.
title: White Water Summer

overview: The Unsolved Murder of Beverly Lynn Smith, a true-crime docuseries that follows the cold case and controversial investigation into the murder of Beverly Lynn Smith in her home in Oshawa, Ontario. Woven together from firsthand accounts, expert interviews, family archives, and rare access to key participants. It's an unpredictable tale that explores the unrelenting enigma of ethics and accountability in this provocative criminal case.
title: The Unsolved Murder of Beverly Lynn Smith

overview: Ondskan will revolve around a troubled young man, Erik, who gets expelled from his school in Stockholm due to his violent behavior. He gets transferred to the boarding school Stjernsberg, where the violence is worse than at home. While there, he engages in a forbidden love relationship with a kitchen staff member, Marja.
title: Ondskan

overview: A newcomer Sawatari Miya and a senior reporter Otobe Ryo will infiltrate the dark world via a horror web media called "Yamibu" with a mission to approach the truth of various mysterious phenomena. It is a drama where viewers can experience a mysterious horror that is a mixture of fiction and reality.
title: Yamibu Real

overview: The Aztec Empire came to an end at the hands of Conquistador Hernan Cortes but not before Emperor Montezuma, and his people, were able to sneak their mass amounts of wealth north to seven separate locations in what is now the American Southwest. For five centuries, thousands have searched for Montezuma's treasure and the 7 Cities of Gold. The treasure is believed to be made up of an enormous quantity of gold bars, silver, precious stones, jewelry, and other Aztec artifacts. Historians estimate the value of all of these items to be worth over $3 billion dollars. Lost Gold of the Aztecs follows three families determined to break the 500-year-old curse of Emperor Montezuma and find the treasure. The series will intercut each family's epic adventure as they search for the 7 Cities of Gold on three different properties in three different states - the Dillmans in Utah, the Hoaglands in Nevada, and the Villescases in New Mexico. Who will be the first to find the Aztec Gold?
title: Lost Gold of the Aztecs

overview: Adapted from the novels "Hatashijo" (はたし状), "Dorobo to Wakatono" (泥棒と若殿), "Banshu" (晩秋), and "On'na wa Onaji Monogatari" (女は同じ物語).
title: Dare ka ni Hanashitaku Naru Yamamoto Shugoro Higawari Dorama

overview: Gordon Brittas is a Leisure Centre manager with a dream. Due to the unexplained collapse of his last Leisure Centre during his time in temporary charge, he was given a glowing reference and 'encouraged' to take up a managerial position at Whitbury Newtown Leisure Centre. His 'loyal' staff have stories of their own, like Carole Parkinson, the receptionist, whose husband has left her, forcing her to keep her baby in the drawer under her desk. Also Tim Whistler and Gavin Featherly, the fitness instructors whose relationship Brittas always seems to be oblivious to. Julie Porter, Brittas' secretary, is always 'too busy' to do anything for him, and constantly looking for chances to show him up. Linda Perkin, the ever-ready staff member who always believes what Brittas says is best. Laura Lancing, Brittas' hard-working deputy manager is in and out of relationships with her estranged husband, Michael T. Farrell. Finally, Colin Weatherby, Brittas' deputy manager is keen and devoted to anything Brittas says is best, but isn't the cleanest or healthiest of people and always has a bandage over the wound on his hand. Whatever chaotic incidents occur, Brittas and his staff emerge unscathed, from ceiling collapses, rooms full of ice, other world invaders, tropical spiders and propane gas explosions.
title: The Brittas Empire

overview: Toshiro proposes to his girlfriend of three years, Akiko, but Akiko disappears the next day, leaving the engagement ring behind. In this perspective, we find the behind Akiko's "hidden world".
title: Kanojo no Ura Sekai: Akiko Side

overview: A comedy spin on John Hughes' 1984 coming-of-age film Sixteen Candles, 15 Candles follows four young Latinas in high school, navigating feelings of invisibility while exploring what it means to leave childhood behind as quinceañera season approaches.
title: 15 Candles

overview: Two pairs of strangers are stripped of all their clothes and possessions and race in the buff across the English countryside to win a cash prize for charity... and their clothes Do two pairs of strangers have the strength, resilience and resourcefulness to survive in the country's most extreme environments, with nothing but their wits and without alarming the locals?
title: Naked, Alone and Racing to Get Home

overview: Atlas, who was bullied during his high school years; He leaves his hometown with his mother. Years later, he is appointed as a mathematics teacher to his own school.
title: Kara Tahta

overview: In this new spinoff series that begins Wednesday, April 13, at 8pm ET/PT, exclusively on Discovery, Tim and Howard travel across the U.S. to rediscover legendary liquors. They also partner up with Tickle to rebuild ancient pot stills and recreate secret mash bills in a bold attempt to taste American spirits that would otherwise be lost to history. They're on a mission to keep American spirits alive. Each week's episode will focus on a single libation — from Benjamin Franklin's liquor in Philly to Franklin Roosevelt's secret moonshine in Georgia. Join Tim, Howard, and Tickle as they learn about the origins of each spirit and its place in the history books. Get ready to take a sip of history!
title: Moonshiners: American Spirit

overview: After Master Distiller Season 3 ends, the all-new series Moonshiners: Master Distiller Tournament of Champions begins, Wednesday, April 27 at 9pm ET/PT on Discovery and discovery+. The competition features the top distillers going up against each other in a four-episode grand elimination tournament. The top legal and outlaw champions in the history of Master Distiller – Richard, Amanda, Tater, and Mena – compete against still-hand champions, Howard and Daniel. Judges Mark, Digger, and Tim will return, along with special guest judges Josh Owens, Henry Law, Mark Rogers, Danielle Parton, and Popcorn Sutton's spouse, Pam Sutton. With so many talented competitors and incredible judges, you won't want to miss it! Be sure to stay tuned in Wednesday nights through April and May on Discovery.
title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller Tournament of Champions

overview: Gangs of young bricklayers trading banter, earning cash and building their futures through fallouts and friendships, life-changing purchases and relationship dramas.
title: Brickies

overview: A series of four creative performance readings of iconic British novels. Each episode is directed by emerging talent from the New Creatives scheme.
title: The Read

overview: The story of a footballing genius whose on-field brilliance is matched by a troubled private life and a media mania that spirals out of control.
title: Gazza

overview: Since its launch in 2007, BBC Music Introducing has been dedicated to discovering and supporting new music.
title: BBC Music Introducing

overview: Three affluent international private detectives/troubleshooters are charged with ensuring the protection of innocents. They belong to an organization called The Protectors and are based in London. Harry Rule leads the group. The Contessa lives in Italy when she isn't working with Harry; she runs her own detective agency that specializes in exposing art frauds and recovering stolen art. Paul Buchet works out of Paris, and is the group's researcher and gadget specialist.
title: The Protectors

overview: Former operative Vadim Tarasov returns to his hometown with the intention of starting a new life. An employee of the employment center Veronika unexpectedly awakens professional interest in Vadim. He is sure that a closed, extinct woman is hiding some secret from everyone. Vadim starts his own investigation.
title: Первые встречные

overview: Matayoshi's unrivaled chair enthusiast, who has also served as the editor-in-chief of "Matayoshi Naoki Magazine Chair" in the past, has turned into a drama in the newly written story! As the title suggests, it becomes a unique omnibus drama (8 episodes in total) that depicts the life of a woman and "chair", and one real famous chair appears in each episode, and the story also describes the origin and characteristics of that chair. It is an original story woven and spun. It is finished in eight stories about unique and mysterious <chairs and women> with abundant variations, and Matayoshi himself, who wrote it, reveals that it is a strange story that I have never seen ... How is the whole story? One of the highlights of the work is that Riho Yoshioka, Serena Motola, Natsumi Ishibashi, Haru Kuroki, and the four leading actresses play two completely different protagonists. title: Isu
